description: This file provides Portuguese internationalization (i18n) strings for the Select2 plugin, version 4.0.6-rc.1. It defines error messages and prompts used in the UI when the language is set to Portuguese.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns message when results cannot be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns message when input exceeds maximum length, prompting user to delete extra characters.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns message when input is shorter than minimum required characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns message indicating more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns message indicating the maximum number of selectable items has been reached.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns message when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns message while search is in progress.
